# Kone Warp

> Next-generation high-speed dispatch logistics, transit orchestration, and autonomous fleet delivery network by Kone Academy.

Kone Warp provides intelligent delivery and ridesharing transportation infrastructure, bridging real-world mobility with telemetry sensors, smart routing algorithms, and localized dispatch nodes across West Africa.

## Core Capabilities & Fleet Modes

- **EV Micro-Mobility**: Electric bike and scooter couriers optimized for rapid urban package dispatch.
- **Eco-Fleet Transit**: Real-time passenger rideshare with algorithmic vehicle positioning and fuel-efficient routing.
- **Agritech Corridor Supply**: Direct harvest transport routing fresh produce from Volta Region farm plots to Accra packaging centers.
- **Hardware Telemetry**: Integration with Kone Lab solar GPS beacons and onboard diagnostics.

## Parent Ecosystem & Federated Links

- [Kone Academy (Hub)](https://academy.codkon.com/): Central learning portal and technology group.
- [Kone Technologies (Parent)](https://tech.codkon.com/): Corporate holding organization.
- [Kone Lab (Hardware)](https://lab.codkon.com/): Prototyping IoT GPS beacons and vehicle micro-controllers.
- [Kone Farms (Agritech)](https://farms.codkon.com/): Farm-to-kitchen logistics and supply chain routes.
- [Kone Code (Engineering)](https://code.codkon.com/): Backend dispatch algorithms and real-time mapping engine.
- [Kone Consult (Research)](https://consult.codkon.com/): Traffic density analyses and urban logistics telemetry.

## System Architecture

1. **Precision Geolocation**: Real-time Leaflet GIS mapping with live GPS coordinate ingestion.
2. **Automated Dynamic Pricing**: Algorithmic distance and traffic calculation.
3. **Multi-Modal Diagnostics**: On-device telemetry logging ensuring zero-emission routing compliance.
